strings.zh: 治愈球在捕获精灵时,{NEWLINE}能让精灵的体力与异常状态全部回复,{CLEAR}是对精灵非常温柔的球。
strings.en: When a Heal Ball catches{NEWLINE}a Pokémon, it fully restores{CLEAR}the Pokémon’s HP and cures its{CLEAR}status. It’s a very gentle Ball.

strings.zh: 买到精灵球喽！{NEWLINE}这下可以拼命地抓精灵啦！
strings.en: I got some Poké Balls! Now I can{NEWLINE}catch all the Pokémon I want!

strings.zh: 拥有毒疗特性的精灵,{NEWLINE}虽然会在战斗中{CLEAR}因为陷入中毒而回复体力,{CLEAR}但是在战斗外依然会因为中毒{CLEAR}而逐渐虚弱哦。{SCROLL}所以精灵中毒的话,{NEWLINE}还是尽快解毒比较好。
strings.en: A Pokémon with Poison Heal gets{NEWLINE}its HP back when it’s poisoned in{CLEAR}battle. But outside of battle,{CLEAR}the poison still wears it down.{SCROLL}So if your Pokémon is poisoned, it’s{NEWLINE}best to cure it as soon as you can.
